quotes.name: Daniela Kapoor
quotes.quote: Sunday night was a great flight on UNDOCKED. I was happy with how it went, I mined some good resources and jumped around to different systems. I went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, and a few others, and managed to earn a bunch of achievements. It was a lot of fun.
